_meta.purpose: Maps assessment context factors to persona-specific prompt variations, scenario filtering, and report tone. Used by the ReasonLens assessment engine to tailor the experience to each respondent's context.

persona_mappings.label: Secondary School Teacher
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios use classroom, departmental, and whole-school contexts. Reference timetable constraints, assessment pressures, and mixed-ability teaching.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Professional and collegial. Acknowledge the complexity of the secondary school context. Avoid implying the educator needs to do more — frame as 'opportunities to develop'.

context_hints.subject_area: Use to filter subject-relevant scenario stems. Humanities and science contexts available.
context_hints.years_teaching: Early-career teachers may need more scaffolding language. Experienced teachers can handle more challenging nuisance responses.
context_hints.tech_confidence: Low-confidence respondents: use scenarios where the attractive nuisance involves confidence-building but not full standard demonstration.

persona_mappings.label: Primary School Teacher
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios use whole-class, pastoral, and cross-curricular contexts. Avoid references to department structures. Student wellbeing and parental engagement are natural themes.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Warm and practically focused. Primary educators are often generalists — acknowledge breadth of role.

context_hints.subject_area: Less relevant at primary level — use general or cross-curricular scenarios.
context_hints.tech_confidence: Primary sector may have wider confidence variation — calibrate scenarios to stated confidence.

persona_mappings.label: Higher Education Educator
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios use lecture, seminar, and online learning contexts. Reference academic freedom, research-teaching nexus, and student digital literacy in HE.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Peer-level and academically respectful. Avoid language that feels imported from schools. Connect to research-informed practice.

context_hints.subject_area: HE scenarios can use discipline-specific academic contexts (e.g., STEM lab, humanities seminar).
context_hints.years_teaching: Early-career HE educators may be research-primary — acknowledge this in coaching prompts.
